# Spec 004, J11: Job B's packages. Its notebook installs this file with pip --require-hashes --no-deps
# --only-binary before it imports the repo's code, then Job B checks every version against this file.
# Databricks' serverless Python is 3.12 on ARM (the probes of 10 November), and uv.lock holds builds for Python
# 3.13 and later only, so this file is compiled for that platform from pyproject.toml's `cloud` group, with every
# version held to uv.lock's (a test checks them). Made with these commands (review of #108, nit 6):
#    uv export --frozen --only-group cloud --no-emit-project --no-hashes --format requirements-txt
#        | grep -v '^ *#' | sed 's/ *;.*//' > constraints.txt
#    printf 'anthropic==1.13.0\nduckdb==1.5.6\nscikit-learn==1.9.1\n' > cloud.in
#    uv pip compile --python-version 3.12 --python-platform aarch64-manylinux_2_17 --generate-hashes
#        --no-header -c constraints.txt cloud.in
